code:
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: "npm"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
caption: Every other job needs this one — a failing test stops everything downstream.

eyebrow: Stage 2 — build and push the image
code:
build-and-push-image:
  needs: build-and-test
  if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
  steps:
    - uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
      with:
        push: true
        tags: ghcr.io/northbridge-retail/storefront-api:${{ github.sha }}
caption: Only runs on main, tagged with the commit SHA.
